answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 654 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the signal. The marble index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the wharf queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Honest users pay that once, farms 13 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
